instruction_3: Walk past the two urns and turn left. Walk to the entrance of the dining room, straight ahead, and stop under the arch.

instruction_1: Walk through the doorway, take a left through the 2nd doorway, stop right before the plant on the right side.
instruction_2: Walk to the open door. Make a sharp right turn around the corner and walk through the open door into the room with grey tile.
instruction_3: Walk through open door and through hall, stop at bottom of stairs.

instruction_1: Follow the red carpet straight and make the first left where the red carpet continues to go through the wooden doors. Wait outside of the room before entering through the wooden doors.
instruction_2: Exit through double doors, walk along the red carpet to the other end of the room. Wait by the second set of double doors.
instruction_3: Walk down the hallway and pass all the picture frames placed on the right until the end. Turn left to enter another room, and stop there.

instruction_1: Walk down stairs. Once you reach the bottom, turn hard left. Enter the room straight ahead. Wait here.
instruction_2: Descend down the stairs. Turn left and stop in the room.
instruction_3: Go down the stairs, Turn left and enter the room. Wait near the chairs that are facing the fireplace.

instruction_1: Walk to the left, going towards the right arch at the back of the room. Walk through to the next room and stop when you're at the rug in front of the dining set.
instruction_2: Walk out of the living room past the couches. Go straight into the dining room and a stop behind the second chair on the left.
instruction_3: Walk past the white couch on the left. Go through the entryway and past the oval table. Stop at the rectangular table.

instruction_1: Leave the closet and bedroom. In the hall go down the stairs. Stop on the third stair from the top.
instruction_2: Walk into the dressing room and turn left. Walk into the bedroom. Turn right and walk past the bedroom to the door on the right. Go through the doorway and wait a few steps down the stairs.
instruction_3: Exit the closet and go to the left towards the bed. Go to the right to exit the bedroom. Go left and go down the stairs. Stop on the third stair.

instruction_1: Walk forward down the hall and turn right at the stairs. Walk past the stairs and into the next room. Wait near the entrance way.
instruction_2: Walk down hallway, turn right at stairs going down and continue into living room.
instruction_3: Go straight then turn right. Go straight until you get to a large room. Wait at the entrance.

instruction_1: Walk down the hallway to the end. Turn left into the laundry room and wait in the doorway.
instruction_2: Walk to end of hallway. Wait in threshold of laundry room.
instruction_3: Walk to the end of the hallway, pass the bathroom and wait by the laundry room.

instruction_1: Face sink and turn right. Exit the room through the door. Turn right and walk between chairs and couch. Stop near round table.
instruction_2: Walk away from the grill, and into the house the other direction. Take a right in the hall, and go past the kitchen. Enter the dining room with the round table, and stop in front of the console table.
instruction_3: Go straight and out the room. Turn right and go straight. Pass the bar with the stools/chairs and the couches. Continue straight until you get to a round table and chairs.

instruction_1: Exit bathroom and follow hallway through archway directly in front. Turn right when hallway ends at pictures and table. Follow hallway passed piano and stop in the circle on the hallway floor.
instruction_2: Walk down the hallway and take a right. Walk past the piano and wait by the violin hanging on the wall.
instruction_3: walk out of the bathroom and down the hall. Turn right at the end of the hallway. Walk past the piano. Stop under the large chandelier by the violin.

instruction_1: Turn around and go through the archway. Turn to the left of the door and stop in the bathroom.
instruction_2: Exit the bedroom and walk strait across the hallway. Enter the door at the back of the bedroom and wait near the sink.
instruction_3: Walk across the hall, through the bedroom and stop inside the en suite bathroom.

instruction_1: Exit the massage room and go straight across the hallway through the brown double doors, go down the steps and stop.
instruction_2: Turn around and walk into the room with the pool. Walk down the stairs and wait at the bottom of the stairs.
instruction_3: Exit the bathroom then go straight until you get to a room. Wait by the desk.

instruction_1: Go down the hallway, turn left in the circle room, go into the doorway before the mirror and take a few steps in and stop.
instruction_2: Head down the hallway pass the picture on the right of the people on horseback. At the intersection turn left. Go into the bedroom and stop next to the rug.
instruction_3: Exit the bedroom and take a left. Enter another bedroom and wait there, next to the table and lamp.

instruction_1: Head down first flight of stairs and at landing turn right to go down next second flight of stairs. At landing of second flight of stairs veer to the right and turn right into first door way. Stop just inside of doorway.
instruction_2: Go down the stairs. Turn right and continue going down the stairs. Walk straight and slightly right down the hallway.Go into the room on the right. Wait there.
instruction_3: Turn around and walk down the stairs. Wait in the entry way of the living area on the right.

instruction_1: Exit bathroom and turn right into kitchen. Stop before kitchen island.
instruction_2: Leave the bathroom and turn right. Walk straight until you enter the kitchen area and stop in front of the island counter.
instruction_3: Exit the bathroom and turn right. Continue straight down the hall until you reach the kitchen.

instruction_1: Walk straight down the hallway until you get to the kitchen. Pass the bar with the chairs/stools. Walk straight until you get to a ledge on the left wall with a vase and white flowers. Wait there.
instruction_2: Go to the far end of the hall. Wait outside the dining room archway.
instruction_3: Turn left and walk down the hallway. Continue to walk straight through the kitchen. Stop next to the white flowers on the left.

instruction_1: Facing the clock turn left, at the intersection turn right, before the bookshelves turn right, at the intersection turn left and turn into the doorway and stop.
instruction_2: Turn left and then turn right into the hallway. Walk straight until almost get to a room with a bookcase.Before you go to the room turn right and then turn left and go into the bathroom. Wait near the sink.
instruction_3: Leave the sitting room and go left. Take a right before you enter the foyer. Take a right before you enter the office area. Enter the bathroom on the left.

instruction_1: Go straight into the kitchen, turn left and go passed the bar. Go to the end of the hallway and stop in front of the sink and shelves.
instruction_2: Walk toward the kitchen counter and turn left. Walk into the kitchen past the stove and refrigerator and stop in front of the sink.
instruction_3: Walk passed the right of the bar, and turn left to walk through the kitchen. Stop once you reach the shelves on your right.

instruction_1: Go down the stairs and turn right. Keep going down the stairs and stop in the doorway of the living room.
instruction_2: Walk all the way to the bottom on both flight of stairs, Walk straigh the the hallway to your left, and stop right before the rug.,.
instruction_3: Walk down the stairs and to the right. Walk down the stairs and stop in front of the table.

instruction_1: Turn left and enter the bedroom on the left. Turn left and walk all the way down the hallway until you reach a wall. Enter the bedroom to your left and stop.
instruction_2: Leave the bathroom, and the bedroom. Enter the bedroom on the far left in the hall. Stop in the doorway.
instruction_3: Exit bathroom and turn left, go through door and turn left, walk through door and go past rails, turn left at door and wait there.

instruction_1: Walk straight across the wine cellar and exit out the door on the other side. Once out turn left and then enter in the door to your left in the corner. Stop once you enter the open room with several large cabinets.
instruction_2: Walk forward past the racks of wine bottles until you exit the wine cellar. Turn to your left and enter the first room on your left. Wait on the rug just inside the room.
instruction_3: Go straight through the wine room and pass through the open gated glass door. Turn sharply left and go through the open door on your left. Wait just outside the door on the rug.

instruction_1: Turn around and walk out the double doors. Go across the next room and out the door. Stop once you enter the next room with tile floor.
instruction_2: Walk all the way forward and enter another door. Keep walking forward on the red carpet, and stop where the tiles are on the ground, and the end of the carpet.
instruction_3: Stand with the bed behind you and walk straight down the red carpet. Go into the room with the tile floor and stop after a few steps closer to the middle of the room.

instruction_1: Exit the bathroom and walk down the hall to the second doorway on your left. Turn left and enter the room through that doorway.
instruction_2: Walk out of the bathroom past the sink and shower. Walk through the arched doorway down the hall with the throw rug. Walk into the room with wooden closet doors and two ceiling lamps.
instruction_3: Leave the bathroom and walk straight into the hallway. Go straight and enter the office in the second door on your left.

instruction_1: Continue forward until you reach the top of the steps and change your direction to the left. Travel forward until you reach the base of the next staircase on your right. Ascend the stairs until you reach the top step. Halt here.
instruction_2: Go to the top of the stairs and turn left. Go past the fake tree to the base of the stairs and go up the stairs. Stop at the top of the stairs.
instruction_3: Walk up the steps and turn left. Walk toward the front door and turn right at the steps. Walk up the stairs and stop at the top of the steps.

instruction_1: With the window behind you, walk straight past the table and kitchen area and through the doorway. Keep going until you get to a separate sitting room on the left with blue walls and white couches. Walk into the room and stop once you step on the carpet.
instruction_2: Walk past the table and chairs. Walk past the bar with the stools. After you pass that turn left and wait near the two white couches and the coffee table.
instruction_3: Walk on the left side of the table straight towards the couch and kitchen counter. Walk between the couch and counter and continue until straight. At the large clock on the wall turn left into the sitting area. And stop near the sofa on the left.

instruction_1: Turn ro your left and exit into the hallway. Turn left and enter the bedroom and then turn left and enter the closet.
instruction_2: Exit the bedroom. Go to the next bedroom on the left. Go to the foot of the bed. Go into the closet across from the blue bed.
instruction_3: Stand so the foot of the bed is to your right and walk out of the room, going past a big mirror on the way. Once outside walk straight until you see an open door to a bedroom on your left. Walk into the room and stand at the foot of the bed with the bed behind you. Walk through the doorway on the left into the closet. Stop in this doorway.

instruction_1: Walk up brown wooden steps, and head inside through sliding glass door. Walk to couch. Wait here.
instruction_2: Walk straight until you get to a porch. Go up the steps of the porch and into the house using the glass double doors. Wait near the tv.
instruction_3: Walk forward and turn right towards the three stairs to enter the house. Walk forward towards the glass door on the very left corner, and stop there.

instruction_1: Turn right and enter through the sliding door. Continue past the TV on the right. Enter the kitchen and wait beside the fridge.
instruction_2: Go toward the white table on the patio. Turn right and go inside through the sliding doors. Go through the room with television and into the kitchen. Stop nest to the stove and island in the kitchen.
instruction_3: Walk toward the white patio table and chairs and go into the house through the glass sliding doors. Pass the grey couches and go into the kitchen. Wait by the toaster.
